limitations_and_boundaries: The study uses hPSC-derived cells, which may not fully recapitulate in vivo neuroinflammation.
The tri-culture system is an in vitro model and may not capture all aspects of cellular cross-talk present in the brain.
The C3 KO experiments were performed in H1 hESC background; APPSWE+/+ lines were in H9 background.
Sample sizes were not predetermined by statistical methods but were similar to previous publications.
Data distribution was assumed to be normal but not formally tested.
The mechanistic role of C1Q in C3 induction was postulated but not directly demonstrated.
The selected source chunks do not report a rescue, reconstitution, reversal, or epistasis experiment; that rung of the causal evidence chain remains untested within this extraction scope.

research_questions.statement: Can a defined hPSC-derived tri-culture system containing microglia, astrocytes, and neurons be developed to dissect cellular cross-talk in neuroinflammation, and what are the cellular contributions to increased complement C3 production in Alzheimer's disease?

claims.statement: A narrow developmental window (18–24 h after WNT activation) is required for efficient generation of KDR+CD235A+ primitive hemangioblasts from hPSCs.

experiments_or_tasks: Differentiation of hPSCs into microglial precursors via primitive hematopoiesis by sequential WNT activation (CHIR99021) and WNT inhibition (IWP2) with Nodal activation (activin A).
Flow cytometry analysis of hematopoietic lineage markers (CD41, CD235A, CD43, CD45) at days 6 and 10.
Isolation of KDR+CD235A+ and KDR+CD235A− populations by cell sorting and replating in hematopoietic cytokines to assess hematopoietic potential.
Optimization of cell density and small-molecule concentrations for hemangioblast generation.
Time-course analysis of WNT inhibition window (12, 18, 24, 36 h) to optimize KDR+CD235A+ hemangioblast emergence.

experiments_or_tasks: Assembly of tri-cultures containing hPSC-derived microglia, astrocytes, and neurons (APPSWE+/+ or isogenic WT).
C3 and C1Q protein measurement by ELISA and Luminex.
C3 KO hPSC lines generated by CRISPR-Cas9; tri-cultures with C3 KO astrocytes (C3KOA) or C3 KO microglia (C3KOM).
Conditioned medium transfer experiments (microglia-conditioned medium to astrocyte/neuron; astrocyte-conditioned medium to microglia/neuron).
LPS stimulation (1 μg/ml, 72 h) to induce inflammation.

methods.name: ELISA/Luminex
methods.protocol_description: Culture supernatants were analyzed for C3 and C1Q using the Millipore Luminex Multiplex Kit on the FlexMap 3D system. Supernatants were also sent to Eve Technologies for multiplexed analysis of 14 inflammatory cytokines.

methods.name: CRISPR-Cas9 knockout
methods.protocol_description: The PX458 vector containing guide 5′ TCTGCACTATCCAGGTA 3′ was nucleofected into H1 hESCs. Cells were sorted on GFP expression, cultured as single-cell clones, and screened for indels by Sanger sequencing. Clones were validated by ELISA for lack of C3 secretion.
